caption: The drawing depicts a central red heart shape with a black cross on top of it, and a green thorny vine wrapping horizontally around the heart. The heart is positioned within a yellowish-beige oval area that is surrounded by a thick, dark green border, all contained within a square or rectangular frame with a dark red background and dark brown outline. Radiating red lines emanate outward from the heart across the yellowish oval background. The overall composition is centered, with the heart and cross as the focal point, and ample blank, off-white space surrounding the main image.
title: Retablo
